scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b apps/server packages/story-schema packages/game-runtime packages/api-contract && node node_modules/vue-tsc/bin/vue-tsc.js --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: pnpm run story:compile -- --strict && pnpm run typecheck && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web
scripts.e2e: echo "Playwright e2e 由独立 worker 实例驱动；当前先运行 pnpm test 作为最小验收。" && pnpm test
